text:
rachel (Partnerships): Quick thread: proposing a "staged-convert" marketplace offer that bundles HW rebates + SI activation credits but prevents gaming and protects ARR. looking for ops/legal/finance sanity checks.
omar (Sales): short: love it. main ask: clear floor so AEs can forecast. don't want to undercut direct deals.
jin (Product): UX ask: show "Intro (limited)" and "Year 1 guidance" rows, plus a small "redeem rules" tooltip. need capacity SKU mapping if HW rebate redeems to dedicated.
rachel (Partnerships): draft terms below — want guardrails and expiry windows:```
STAGED-CONVERT OFFER
- TRIAL (60d): 30% off list, min $10k commit, $2k onboarding credit (applied up-front), SI activation credit $1k after checklist
- COMMIT (12mo): 18% off list, true-up, onboarding credit $1k, HW rebate up to $6k redeemable only against Reserved/Dedicated capacity SKUs within 180d
GUARDRAILS:
- Credits do NOT stack; highest applicable applies
- Cap total redeemable credits per account to $20k
- Rebate requires invoice proof + capacity SKU ID mapping
- If convert-to-Dedicated within 6mo -> return 50% of onboarding credit as capacity credit
```
lucy (Finance): flagged: onboarding credits are contra-revenue and must be amortized over the committed term. cap is good. I need sample ARR scenarios (3 churn bands). I'll run them and confirm proration rules.
diego (Solutions): SI checklist: integration runbook, sample payloads, test harness pass, co-marketing blurb. SI credit only after checklist validated. also propose a 45-day SLA for SI checklist completion or offer lapses.
ops (Eng): ops items: pricing-mask staging, entitlement flags, billing-hook smoke tests, telemetry for redemption events, SKU-list for mapping. can validate sandbox Weds AM.
omar (Sales): renewal incentive: if customer renews at >=110% consumption, extend COMMIT discount by 3ppt next year. helps retention.
jin (Product): small UX tweak: when rebate is "redeemable only for Dedicated" show a tiny badge that links to capacity SKU list and instructions.
announce-bot: Draft listing saved -> https://redwood.docs/marketplace/staged-convert-draft (owner: rachel).
lucy (Finance): action: I'll deliver ARR sensitivity + rev-rec note by Thu COB.
rachel (Partnerships): action: I'll finalize playbook + LOA timeline (T-6w assets, T-3w LOA, T-2w enablement, T-1w legal) by Tue. diego: publish SI checklist by Fri. ops: run sandbox validation Wed. any objections? :rocket:
